+def _apply_merges_long(ids, ranks, merges_get, inf):
+    """
+    Same steps and result as the loop in apply_merges, for long sequences:
+    instead of min(ranks) and ranks.count(idx) (two full passes per merge
+    step), keep a count of every rank value in ranks, updated for each rank
+    that is replaced, dropped or added, plus a heap of the rank values
+    (stale entries, whose count dropped to zero, are skipped lazily). The
+    heap top is then min(ranks) and cnt[idx] is ranks.count(idx).
+    """
+    cnt = {}
+    _count_elements(cnt, ranks)
+    cnt_get = cnt.get
+    heap = list(cnt)
+    heapify(heap)
+    while heap:
+        idx = heap[0]
+        if not cnt[idx]:
+            heappop(heap) # stale
+            continue
+        if idx == inf:
+            break # nothing else can be merged anymore
+        j = ranks.index(idx)
+        k = cnt[idx]
+        if k == 1:
+            # single occurrence: splice it in place, recompute the neighbours
+            cnt[idx] = 0
+            ids[j] = idx
+            del ids[j+1]
+            del ranks[j]
+            if j:
+                cnt[ranks[j-1]] -= 1
+                r = ranks[j-1] = merges_get((ids[j-1], idx), inf)
+                c = cnt_get(r, 0)
+                cnt[r] = c + 1
+                if not c:
+                    heappush(heap, r)
+            if j < len(ranks):
+                cnt[ranks[j]] -= 1
+                r = ranks[j] = merges_get((idx, ids[j+1]), inf)
+                c = cnt_get(r, 0)
+                cnt[r] = c + 1
+                if not c:
+                    heappush(heap, r)
+            continue
+        p0 = ids[j]
+        p1 = ids[j+1]
+        last = len(ranks) - 1 # last pair position
+        newids = []
+        ext = newids.extend
+        app = newids.append
+        newranks = []
+        rext = newranks.extend
+        rapp = newranks.append
+        index = ranks.index
+        added = [] # new rank values; each replaces the old rank at a position in dropped
+        add = added.append
+        dropped = []
+        drop = dropped.append
+        s = 0 # start of the not yet copied part of ids / ranks
+        first = True
+        while True:
+            k -= 1
+            if ids[j] == p0 and ids[j+1] == p1:

+                        add(r)
